sections.heading: Learning Point 7
sections.content: Foreword Foreword The National Education Policy 2020 envisages a system of education in the country that is rooted in Indian ethos and its civilisational accomplishments in all domains of human endeavour and knowledge, while at the same time preparing the students to constructively engage with the prospects and challenges of the 21st century.
sections.source_evidence: Foreword Foreword The National Education Policy 2020 envisages a system of education in the country that is rooted in Indian ethos and its civilisational accomplishments in all domains of human endeavour and knowledge, while at the same time preparing the students to constructively engage with the prospects and challenges of the 21st century.

sections.heading: Learning Point 8
sections.content: The basis for this aspirational vision has been well laid out by the National Curriculum Framework for School Education (NCF-SE) 2023 across curricular areas at all stages.
sections.source_evidence: The basis for this aspirational vision has been well laid out by the National Curriculum Framework for School Education (NCF-SE) 2023 across curricular areas at all stages.

sections.heading: Learning Point 9
sections.content: Having nurtured the students’ inherent abilities touching upon all five planes of human existence, the pañchakośhas in the Foundational and the Preparatory Stages have paved the way for the progression of their learning further at the Middle Stage.
sections.source_evidence: Having nurtured the students’ inherent abilities touching upon all five planes of human existence, the pañchakośhas in the Foundational and the Preparatory Stages have paved the way for the progression of their learning further at the Middle Stage.

sections.heading: Learning Point 10
sections.content: Thus, the Middle Stage acts as a bridge between the Preparatory and the Secondary Stages, spanning three years from Grade 6 to Grade 8.
sections.source_evidence: Thus, the Middle Stage acts as a bridge between the Preparatory and the Secondary Stages, spanning three years from Grade 6 to Grade 8.

sections.heading: Learning Point 11
sections.content: The NCF-SE 2023, at the Middle Stage, aims to equip students with the skills that are needed to grow, as they advance in their lives.
sections.source_evidence: The NCF-SE 2023, at the Middle Stage, aims to equip students with the skills that are needed to grow, as they advance in their lives.

sections.heading: Learning Point 12
sections.content: It endeavours to enhance their analytical, descriptive, and narrative capabilities, and to prepare them for the challenges and opportunities that await them.
sections.source_evidence: It endeavours to enhance their analytical, descriptive, and narrative capabilities, and to prepare them for the challenges and opportunities that await them.

sections.heading: Learning Point 13
sections.content: A diverse curriculum, covering nine subjects ranging from three languages — including at least two languages native to India — to Science, Mathematics, Social Sciences, Art Education, Physical Education and Well-Being, and Vocational Education promotes their holistic development.
sections.source_evidence: A diverse curriculum, covering nine subjects ranging from three languages — including at least two languages native to India — to Science, Mathematics, Social Sciences, Art Education, Physical Education and Well-Being, and Vocational Education promotes their holistic development.

sections.heading: Learning Point 14
sections.content: Such a transformative learning culture requires certain essential conditions.
sections.source_evidence: Such a transformative learning culture requires certain essential conditions.

sections.heading: Learning Point 15
sections.content: One of them is to have appropriate textbooks in different curricular areas as these textbooks will play a central role in mediating between content and pedagogy — a role that will strike a judicious balance between direct instruction and opportunities for exploration and inquiry.
sections.source_evidence: One of them is to have appropriate textbooks in different curricular areas as these textbooks will play a central role in mediating between content and pedagogy — a role that will strike a judicious balance between direct instruction and opportunities for exploration and inquiry.

sections.heading: Learning Point 16
sections.content: Among the other conditions, classroom arrangement and teacher preparation are crucial to establish conceptual connections both within and across curricular areas.
